messages:
tara: Heads up, we started the tls-min-version enforcement roll at 09:02 UTC and some services in ap-south reported mTLS handshake failures.
eli: which services? any commonalities (proxy, edge, internal)?
raj: proxy-edge and svc-ingest in ap-south and eu-west. Logs show `handshake_failure` and then a KMS decrypt deny during cert issuance for the session ticket key.
tara: sample from edge: 
```
2026-03-22T09:06:11Z proxy-edge ap-south ERROR tls: handshake_failure cipher=TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
2026-03-22T09:06:12Z keystore ap-south ERROR kms: DecryptDenied key=arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:999888777:key/kk-1234 principal=svc-cert-issuer@infra.example.com
```
eli: hmm we tightened keystore RBAC last night to restrict key unwrap to `svc-cert-issuer@infra.example.com` only, but some older rotator instances still present `svc-keystore-legacy` identity.
security-bot: policy-change-#214 applied 2026-03-22T02:18Z. Diff snippet: `- members: ["serviceAccount:svc-keystore-legacy@..."] \n+ members: ["serviceAccount:svc-cert-issuer@..."]`.
tara: that explains the KMS denies. But why handshake_failure for TLS1.2 ciphers specifically?
raj: because the cert issuance failed for ephemeral ticket keys, so older clients falling back to TLS1.2 couldn't resume sessions. Our enforcement also disabled fallback cipher suites, exposing the missing ticket keys.
eli: mitigation plan: 1) restore unwrap permission for svc-keystore-legacy for a 20m window, 2) restart legacy rotators to pick up new policy, 3) audit logs to add rbac-change-id on KMS denies so we can correlate.
audrey: I'll open INC-20260322-07 and assign P2.
tara: quick commands I used in ap-south to add temporary binding (AWS example): 
```
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id kk-1234 --policy file://tmp-allow-legacy.json
# tmp-allow-legacy.json contains a single additional principal binding for svc-keystore-legacy
```
raj: for customers using GCP CMEK, equivalent: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding kk-1234 --location=asia-south1 --keyring=prod-kr --member=serviceAccount:svc-keystore-legacy@infra.example.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
eli: we should not rely on manual JSON edits. Add an idempotent `overlap-window` flag to RBAC automation so when replacing principals we automatically grant both principals for N minutes.
tara: yes. Also we need richer audit logging: on KMS Deny, include `principal`, `keyId`, `rbac-change-id`, `policy-commit-id` and push those to security-log topic.
audrey: tagging the logging follow-up to me. I'll add a small change to the forwarder: `if message =~ /DecryptDenied/ { add_field => { \"rbac_change_id\" => \"%{[rbac][change_id]}\" } }`
security-bot: note: several services still report degraded latency due to failed session resumption; mitigation in progress.
raj: smoke check suggestion: post-RBAC job should call these endpoints and verify TLS handshake and ticket unwrap. Example: 
```
# simple test
openssl s_client -connect proxy-edge.eu-west:443 -tls1_2 -cipher ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
# then check logs for 'unwrap OK' for session ticket key
```
eli: also, add a pre-commit hook to the RBAC CI that scans for principals in active rollout groups. If a principal exists in >1 region, warn before prune.
audrey: I'll create a vuln triage ticket to track this as a risky automation change and link policy diffs.
tara: once we have 20m overlap + smoke checks in the pipeline, we can re-run the tls-min-version enforcement.
ops-bot: incident INC-20260322-07 created and assigned to tara, raj, audrey. ETA for containment 30m.
eli: follow ups: - raj: verify legacy restarts picked up policy - tara: confirm unwrap logs show OK across ap-south/eu-west - audrey: add RBAC overlap flag + logging change - security-bot: schedule postmortem in 48h
raj: legacy unwrap success in ap-south at 09:22 UTC: 
```
2026-03-22T09:22:08Z keystore ap-south INFO kms: unwrap OK key=kk-1234 principal=svc-keystore-legacy
2026-03-22T09:22:10Z proxy-edge ap-south INFO tls: session_resume OK client=svc-ingest
```
tara: containment confirmed. moving to vuln triage and automation fixes. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
